tables.name: option_chain_daily_snapshot
tables.paper_action: Fetch missing trading-day partitions only; reuse stored partitions unless force is requested.

tables.name: reverse_lowjump_iv_daily_panel
tables.source: Toolkit product ATM-IV history and daily option snapshots
tables.paper_action: Append T after the daily snapshot is complete. Rolling fields must use observations through T only.

tables.name: reverse_lowjump_product_side_opportunities
tables.paper_action: Append T product-side opportunities and write approved external S1 sell intents.

tables.name: reverse_lowjump_side_flow_guard_panel
tables.source: Toolkit option-side OI/volume and underlying futures OI/volume
tables.paper_action: Update T-day flow guard fields using same-day and trailing observations only.

tables.name: reverse_lowjump_side_iv_pressure_panel
tables.source: T-day near-month OTM put/call IV pressure candidates
tables.paper_action: Recompute after the T snapshot to choose the higher-IV-pressure side and weak-pressure delta cut.

tables.name: iv_pullback_overlay_atm_iv_panel
tables.source: Toolkit option snapshots from 2018-01-01 for the sidecar scan universe
tables.paper_action: Append product-day ATM IV and expanding percentile. Trigger columns use lag1 through lag4 only.

tables.name: iv_pullback_overlay_contract_candidates
tables.source: T-day near-month OTM contract candidates when an overlay trigger is active
tables.paper_action: Recompute from the T snapshot; select the higher-IV-pressure side.

tables.name: overlay_opened_expiry_ledger
tables.paper_action: Persist product+expiry keys so the sidecar opens at most once per product expiry.

tables.name: expiry_underlying_settlement_price
tables.source: Toolkit future_daily_quote settlement/close, Toolkit underlying daily close, and exact Toolkit daily snapshot spot_close/PCP fallback
tables.paper_path: on-demand Toolkit lookup by underlying_code on expiry date
tables.paper_action: At expiry, settle by intrinsic value using same-day future settlement first, then same-day future close, then same-day underlying close, then exact same-underlying or same-expiry daily snapshot spot_close/PCP fallback. Do not use stale cached spot or cross-month same-product substitutes.

tables.name: paper_account_state
tables.source: Fills, positions, NAV, fees, and current margin
tables.paper_action: Refresh before daily order generation; used for margin and overlay stop audit.

tables.name: paper_close_mark
tables.source: Paper account positions and Toolkit T-day option close snapshot
tables.paper_action: Compute T close mark, daily PnL, daily return, stale marks, and margin estimate before T+1 order generation.

tables.name: external_intent_schedule
tables.source: Approved S1 daily signal builder output
tables.paper_action: Clean S1-only handoff into order review and Toolkit minute replay. Generated schedules are local data artifacts.
